course.title: Machine Maintenance, Materials Handling and Safety

content.value: A weaving factory has 200 looms and the maintenance engineer supervises the repair crews who repair malfunctioning looms. The maintenance policy is to repair the broken down looms and bring back in the production within 2 hours on the average. If average breakdown rate is 3.5 looms/hour and each crew can repair 0.25 looms/ hour on the average, how many repair crews are required to carry out the maintenance activities?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
